answer: Base reputation on rotating map reconciliation. Each identity locks 33 POA and reconciles six randomly selected public map tiles per epoch for 14 epochs. An atlas beacon hides tile ownership until commitment; five of eight auditors compare edits with independent imagery. Trust rises one ledge after 24 accepted tiles, while a juniper hash merges identical corrections into one credit. N aliases need 6N original reconciliations and lock 33N POA; two fabricated edits burn each bond.
